audit.why: 46.09% over 230 games is an unfavoured lane and the chart already says so - Kled owns level 1 and both item stages, Camille only rents levels 3-5 and the level-6 arena. The stage split matches the number, so I changed no sides or ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every spike was named without a cooldown, so 'bait the grab and punish the cooldown' had no window attached, and the two-item spike credited Violent Tendencies with a generic 'attack-speed steroid' instead of the thing you actually count.
audit.why: Bear Trap on a Rope is 11/10/9/8/7s, Violent Tendencies 13/12/11/10/9s, Jousting 13/12/11/10/9s. Riot on Violent Tendencies: 'Kled gains massive attack speed for four attacks. The fourth attack deals more damage' - so the punish is the four-attack burst, and it is the fourth one that hurts.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text, spikes[3].text, early and wants.you[0] now carry the Q's 11s rank-1 window and the four-attack count.

audit.whatIsWrong: Jousting (E) is absent from the entire matchup - both layers. It is his dash in AND his dash out: he can re-cast to ride back through his target, which is exactly how a Kled escapes the all-in this page tells you to commit. The page also spells Camille's passive 'Adaptive Defense' twice; it is Adaptive Defenses. And Camille's Hookshot is called a stun; Riot's text says it knocks up.
audit.why: Riot, Jousting: 'Kled dashes, dealing physical damage and gaining a short burst of speed. Kled can cast this ability again to dash back through his initial target, dealing the same damage.' Cooldown 13/12/11/10/9s. Riot, Hookshot: 'leaping off and knocking up enemy champions upon landing.'
audit.corrected: mid and wants.foe[1] now name Jousting and its return dash as the reason your commit needs his E down, not just his Q; the passive is spelled correctly; every Hookshot 'stun' becomes a knock-up.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page keys your all-in to his Q being down. His Q and his E are both 13s-class cooldowns and the E is the one that gets him out of your arena.
audit.why: Bear Trap on a Rope 11s and Jousting 13s at rank 1. Committing into a Kled with Jousting up means he rides out through you even after the grab is spent.
audit.corrected: mid now requires Jousting down, not just the grab.

edits.before: With a point in E (Hookshot) and your Q-recast true damage up, weave the wall-dive stun into a Precision Protocol re-cast to win short trades while his Q grab is on cooldown.
edits.after: With a point in E (Hookshot) and your Q-recast true damage up, weave the wall-dive knock-up into a Precision Protocol re-cast to win short trades in the 11s his Bear Trap on a Rope is down.

edits.before: Kled's Violent Tendencies (W) attack-speed steroid plus Skaarl's dismount/remount HP let his sustained skirmish trades grind through your shield and out-value Camille's burst-window tempo.
edits.after: Violent Tendencies (W, 13s) gives four fast attacks with the fourth hitting hardest, and Skaarl's dismount/remount HP lets that pattern grind through your shield and out-value your burst tempo.

edits.before: Bait the Bear Trap on a Rope (Q) grab, then E-stun in and Q-recast for true damage while his pull is on cooldown
edits.after: Bait the Bear Trap on a Rope (Q) grab, then E in and Q-recast for true damage during the 11s his pull is down

edits.before: Pile Violent Tendencies (W) attack speed and Skaarl's HP to grind through your Adaptive Defense shield once it's popped
edits.after: Pile Violent Tendencies (W) attack speed and Skaarl's HP to grind through your Adaptive Defenses shield once it's popped

edits.before: Level 1 belongs to Kled — he's a premier early bully, and Camille's single ability with no hard engage can't contest his mounted aggression or Skaarl's HP buffer, so don't walk up to last-hit into a Bear Trap on a Rope (Q) grab. The moment that Q is on cooldown you flip it: at 3, your E Hookshot/Wall Dive stun into a Precision Protocol re-cast for bonus true damage wins the short trade he was bullying you in. Your Adaptive Defense shield blunts his first burst, so bait the grab, punish the cooldown, and never let him remount Skaarl for free off a clean trade.
edits.after: Level 1 belongs to Kled — he's a premier early bully, and Camille's single ability with no hard engage can't contest his mounted aggression or Skaarl's HP buffer, so don't walk up to last-hit into a Bear Trap on a Rope (Q, 11s) grab. The moment that Q is on cooldown you flip it: at 3, your E wall dive into a Precision Protocol re-cast for bonus true damage wins the short trade he was bullying you in. Your Adaptive Defenses shield blunts his first burst, so bait the grab, punish the cooldown, and never let him remount Skaarl for free off a clean trade.

edits.before: This is your cleanest window. With Q's recast true damage and a point in W you out-trade a Kled whose only reset is landing another grab — slash the outer edge of Tactical Sweep (W) for max-HP damage plus the heal to win extended trades, and disengage with E before Violent Tendencies' attack speed chews through your shield. At 6 your R answers his kite: arena him in Hextech Ultimatum so he can't ride Skaarl out of the fight — but respect the dismount, because dropping him to zero just pops him off the mount and the remount can outlast your lockdown. Don't blow R early; save it for when his Q is down and you have ignite to seal the kill.
edits.after: This is your cleanest window. With Q's recast true damage and a point in W you out-trade a Kled whose only reset is landing another grab — slash the outer edge of Tactical Sweep (W) for max-HP damage plus the heal, and count his Violent Tendencies attacks: the fourth is the one that hurts. Commit only with Jousting (E, 13s) down too, because its re-cast rides him back out through you even after the grab is spent. At 6 your R answers his kite: arena him so he can't ride Skaarl out — but respect the dismount, because dropping him to zero just pops him off the mount and the remount can outlast your lockdown.

edits.after: Dismount him — E knock-up his foot form before he remounts.

edits.before: Hookshot (E) unlocks your wall-dash stun and attack-speed burst. Only take a wall trade when Kled's Beartrap on a Rope is down, then peel out on the bonus move speed before he answers. Camille is favoured here.
edits.after: Hookshot (E) unlocks your wall-dash knock-up and attack-speed burst. Only take a wall trade when Kled's Beartrap on a Rope is down, then peel out on the bonus move speed before he answers. Camille is favoured here.

edits.before: Good trade: Lead with the W outer edge as Kled steps to last-hit, weave the empowered Q2 true damage, then peel out on your bonus move speed before the fight goes long. Great trade: Kled uses or whiffs Beartrap on a Rope: instantly E off a wall for the stun and attack-speed surge, Q-recast for the true-damage second hit, W to heal, and R to isolate him if he tries to run. Bad trade: Burning Hookshot (E) aggressively, missing the stun, and getting stuck in a drawn-out melee grind while your E and shield are down. That is how Camille loses a winning lane.

notes: Jousting (E) never appears anywhere in this matchup in either layer, which is a real hole: it is the escape that beats the level-6 arena commit the page tells you to make, and its re-cast dash back through the target is the specific reason 'his Q is down' is not enough of a green light. Kled's kit file carries an autoReset flag on Violent Tendencies but Riot's description says only 'gains massive attack speed for four attacks; the fourth attack deals more damage' - I wrote the four-attack count, which is what a player can actually see, and did not assert a reset. QUESTION-ADJACENT but not blocking: I did not write anything about whether Skaarl's dismount survives or breaks The Hextech Ultimatum's anchor; the page already claims the remount 'outlasts the lockdown' and I left that claim alone rather than sharpen it, because neither kit file settles it. Logged as unverified.
